name: abs
summary: The absolute value of x, item by item.

name: acos
summary: The arc cosine of x, in radians; null outside -1 to 1.

name: aj
summary: As-of join: each row of t with the last row of q that matches it on the leading columns of c and is at or before it on the last one. The result keeps t's value in that last column.

name: aj0
summary: As aj, but the last column of c takes q's value, the time of the row that was found.

name: ajf
summary: As aj, but a null in a column of q leaves t's value in place instead of replacing it.

name: ajf0
summary: As aj0, but a null in a column of q leaves t's value in place instead of replacing it.

name: all
summary: 1b when every item of x is nonzero, and for an empty list.

name: and
summary: The lesser of x and y, item by item, which for booleans is logical AND. The same as &.

name: any
summary: 1b when at least one item of x is nonzero.

name: asc
summary: x sorted ascending, with the sorted attribute set: a list by its items, a dictionary by its values, a table by its columns in order.

name: asin
summary: The arc sine of x, in radians; null outside -1 to 1.

name: asof
summary: The values in table t as of dictionary d: the last row matching d's leading keys whose value in d's last key, usually a time, is at or before d's.

name: atan
summary: The arc tangent of x, in radians.

name: attr
summary: The attribute of x as a symbol: `s sorted, `u unique, `p parted, `g grouped, or the null symbol for none.

name: avg
summary: The arithmetic mean of x as a float, nulls ignored.

name: avgs
summary: The running means of x: item i is the mean of the first i+1 items.

name: bin
summary: Binary search: for each item of y, the index of the last item of sorted x that is at most it, or -1 when every item of x is greater.

name: binr
summary: Binary search: for each item of y, the index of the first item of sorted x that is at least it, or count x when none is.

name: by
summary: Opens the grouping phrase of a select, exec or update: the result is computed once per distinct value of the expressions that follow.

name: ceiling
summary: The smallest integer not less than x, as a long.

name: cols
summary: The column names of table t, or of the table a symbol names.

name: cor
summary: The Pearson correlation of x and y, between -1 and 1.

name: cos
summary: The cosine of x, where x is in radians.

name: count
summary: The number of items in x: rows for a table, 1 for an atom.

name: cov
summary: The population covariance of x and y.

name: cross
summary: Every pairing of an item of x with an item of y, in x-major order; for two tables, every pairing of their rows.

name: csv
summary: The comma character, ",": the delimiter to give 0: when reading or writing comma-separated text.

name: cut
summary: y cut into pieces: of x items each when x is an atom, or starting at each index in x when it is a list.

name: delete
summary: qSQL: t without the rows a where phrase selects, or - as delete c1,c2 from t - without those columns. A table named by symbol is changed in place.

name: deltas
summary: The difference between each item of x and the one before it; the first item is kept as it is. deltas[x;y] takes x as the item before y's first.

name: desc
summary: x sorted descending: a list by its items, a dictionary by its values, a table by its columns in order.

name: dev
summary: The population standard deviation of x.

name: differ
summary: 1b where an item of x is not the same as the one before it; the first is always 1b. differ[x;y] compares y's first item with x.

name: distinct
summary: The different items of x, each once, in the order they first occur.

name: div
summary: Integer division: the floor of x divided by y.

name: do
summary: Evaluates the expressions in order, n times over. It returns nothing.

name: dsave
summary: Saves the global tables named in y splayed under directory x, their symbol columns enumerated against the sym file there. x may be a pair of directory and partition.

name: each
summary: f applied to each item of x.

name: ej
summary: Equi join: each row of t1 paired with every row of t2 that has the same values in columns c.

name: ema
summary: The exponential moving average of y with smoothing factor x, a float between 0 and 1.

name: enlist
summary: A list of one item, x. With several arguments, enlist[x;y;z], a list of them all.

name: eval
summary: The result of evaluating the parse tree x, as parse returns one.

name: except
summary: The items of x that are not items of y, in x's order.

name: exec
summary: qSQL: as select, but the result is not a table - a list for one column, a dictionary of columns for several.

name: exit
summary: Ends the q process with exit code x, calling .z.exit first when it is defined.

name: exp
summary: e raised to the power x.

name: fby
summary: f applied to the items of d grouped by g, each result laid back against the rows of its group. Used in a where phrase to filter by a group's aggregate.

name: fills
summary: x with each null replaced by the last value before it that is not null. fills[x;y] fills y, a null at its start with x.

name: first
summary: The first item of x; the first row of a table.

name: fkeys
summary: A dictionary from each foreign-key column of table t to the table it is a key into.

name: flip
summary: x transposed: the rows of a matrix become columns, a dictionary of equal-length lists becomes a table, and a table that dictionary.

name: floor
summary: The greatest integer not more than x, as a long.

name: from
summary: Names the table a select, exec, update or delete reads.

name: get
summary: The value of the global a symbol names, or the contents of the file a file symbol names.

name: getenv
summary: The value of the environment variable named by symbol x, as a string; empty when it is not set.

name: group
summary: A dictionary from each distinct item of x to the indices where it occurs.

name: gtime
summary: The UTC equivalent of the local timestamp or datetime x.

name: hclose
summary: Closes the file or connection handle x.

name: hcount
summary: The size in bytes of the file named by file symbol x.

name: hdel
summary: Deletes the file or empty directory named by file symbol x, and returns the symbol.

name: hopen
summary: Opens a file or a connection to another process and returns its handle. x is a file symbol, `:host:port[:user:password], or a pair of that and a timeout in milliseconds.

name: hsym
summary: The symbols in x as file or process symbols: each with a leading colon, unless it has one.

name: iasc
summary: The indices that put x in ascending order: x iasc x is x sorted.

name: idesc
summary: The indices that put x in descending order.

name: if
summary: Evaluates the expressions in order when test is nonzero. It returns nothing; for a value use $[test;a;b].

name: ij
summary: Inner join: the rows of t1 whose key is in keyed table t2, with t2's columns for that key.

name: ijf
summary: As ij, but a null in a column of t2 leaves t1's value in place instead of replacing it.

name: in
summary: For each item of x, whether it is an item of y.

name: insert
summary: Appends the records y to the global table named by symbol x and returns the new row numbers. A keyed table refuses a key it already has.

name: inter
summary: The items of x that are also items of y, in x's order.

name: inv
summary: The inverse of the square float matrix x.

name: key
summary: The keys of a dictionary or keyed table. Of other arguments: the names in a namespace or directory, a vector's type, an enumeration's domain, til x for an integer, and whether a name or file exists.

name: keys
summary: The names of the key columns of table t, or of the table a symbol names; empty when it has none.

name: last
summary: The last item of x; the last row of a table.

name: like
summary: Whether string or symbol x matches the pattern y, where ? is any one character, * any run of them and [...] any one of a set.

name: lj
summary: Left join: every row of t1, with the columns of keyed table t2 where its key matches and nulls where none does.

name: ljf
summary: As lj, but a null in a column of t2 leaves t1's value in place instead of replacing it.

name: load
summary: Reads the binary file or splayed table at x into a global named after it, and returns that name.

name: log
summary: The natural logarithm of x; null for a negative number.

name: lower
summary: The string or symbol x in lower case.

name: lsq
summary: Least squares: the matrix w that brings w mmu y closest to x. x and y are float matrices with the same number of columns.

name: ltime
summary: The local equivalent of the UTC timestamp or datetime x.

name: ltrim
summary: The string x without its leading spaces.

name: mavg
summary: The moving average of y: the mean of each item and the x-1 before it, of fewer at the start, nulls ignored.

name: max
summary: The greatest item of x, nulls ignored.

name: maxs
summary: The running maximums of x: item i is the greatest of the first i+1 items. maxs[x;y] runs over y starting from x.

name: mcount
summary: The moving count of y: how many of each item and the x-1 before it are not null.

name: md5
summary: The MD5 digest of the string x, as 16 bytes.

name: mdev
summary: The moving deviation of y: the population standard deviation of each item and the x-1 before it.

name: med
summary: The median of x as a float.

name: meta
summary: The columns of table t, keyed by name c: type character t, foreign-key table f and attribute a.

name: min
summary: The least item of x, nulls ignored.

name: mins
summary: The running minimums of x: item i is the least of the first i+1 items. mins[x;y] runs over y starting from x.

name: mmax
summary: The moving maximum of y: the greatest of each item and the x-1 before it.

name: mmin
summary: The moving minimum of y: the least of each item and the x-1 before it.

name: mmu
summary: The matrix product of float arguments x and y; the dot product of two vectors.

name: mod
summary: The remainder of x divided by y, with the sign of y: -7 mod 3 is 2.

name: msum
summary: The moving sum of y: each item added to the x-1 before it.

name: neg
summary: x negated, item by item.

name: next
summary: Each item's successor: x shifted one place towards the start, with a null at the end.

name: not
summary: 1b where x is zero and 0b elsewhere.

name: null
summary: 1b where an item of x is null.

name: or
summary: The greater of x and y, item by item, which for booleans is logical OR. The same as |.

name: over
summary: Reduces x with f: a binary f is applied between successive items for one result; a unary f is applied again and again until the result stops changing.

name: parse
summary: The parse tree of the q expression in string x, without evaluating it.

name: peach
summary: As each, with the items shared out among the secondary threads or processes the session was started with.

name: pj
summary: Plus join: t1 with the columns of keyed table t2 added to its own where the key matches; other rows are unchanged.

name: prd
summary: The product of the items of x, nulls ignored.

name: prds
summary: The running products of x. prds[x;y] multiplies y's items in, starting from x.

name: prev
summary: Each item's predecessor: x shifted one place towards the end, with a null at the start. prev[x;y] shifts y, with x at the start.

name: prior
summary: Binary f applied between each item of x and the one before it.

name: rand
summary: A random number below the number x, or a random item of the list x.

name: rank
summary: For each item of x, the position it would have were x sorted ascending.

name: ratios
summary: The ratio of each item of x to the one before it; the first item is kept as it is. ratios[x;y] takes x as the item before y's first.

name: raze
summary: The items of x joined into one list, which removes one level of nesting. raze[x;y] joins y's items onto x.

name: read0
summary: The lines of the text file x, as a list of strings.

name: read1
summary: The bytes of the file x, as a byte vector.

name: reciprocal
summary: 1 divided by x, as a float.

name: reval
summary: As eval, with the evaluation restricted: it can change no global and write no file.

name: reverse
summary: The items of x in reverse order.

name: rload
summary: Reads the splayed table in directory x into a global named after it.

name: rotate
summary: y with its items moved x places towards the start - towards the end for a negative x - those pushed off one end returning at the other.

name: rsave
summary: Saves the global table named by symbol x splayed, to a directory of that name.

name: rtrim
summary: The string x without its trailing spaces.

name: save
summary: Writes a global to the file x - the global that file is named after - in the format its extension asks for: binary with none, or csv, txt, xls, xml or json.

name: scan
summary: As over, but returning every intermediate result and not only the last.

name: scov
summary: The sample covariance of x and y.

name: sdev
summary: The sample standard deviation of x.

name: select
summary: qSQL: the rows of t a where phrase keeps, as a table of the columns listed - of all columns when none is - grouped when there is a by phrase.

name: set
summary: Assigns y to the global named by symbol x, or writes it to the file x names - splayed when the path ends in a slash. Returns x.

name: setenv
summary: Sets the environment variable named by symbol x to the string y.

name: show
summary: Prints x to the console, formatted as the session would display it.

name: signum
summary: -1, 0 or 1 as an item of x is negative, zero or positive.

name: sin
summary: The sine of x, where x is in radians.

name: sqrt
summary: The square root of x; null for a negative number.

name: ss
summary: The positions in string x at which pattern y is found.

name: ssr
summary: The string x with each match of pattern y replaced by the string z, or by z applied to the match when z is a function.

name: string
summary: Each atom of x as a string.

name: sublist
summary: The first x items of y, or the last when x is negative; for a pair x, a count starting from an index. Unlike #, it never repeats items to make up the count.

name: sum
summary: The total of the items of x, nulls ignored.

name: sums
summary: The running totals of x. sums[x;y] adds y's items in, starting from x.

name: sv
summary: Scalar from vector. Joins the strings in y with separator x; evaluates the digits y in base x; with ` joins symbols into one name or path; with 0x0 or 0b makes a number from its bytes or bits.

name: svar
summary: The sample variance of x.

name: system
summary: Runs the string x as a q system command or, if it is not one, an operating-system command, and returns what it gave.

name: tables
summary: The names of the tables in namespace x, sorted; tables[] lists the default namespace.

name: tan
summary: The tangent of x, where x is in radians.

name: til
summary: The first x natural numbers: 0 up to x-1.

name: trim
summary: The string x without its leading and trailing spaces.

name: type
summary: The datatype of x as a short: negative for an atom, positive for a vector, 0 for a general list, 98 for a table, 99 for a dictionary.

name: uj
summary: Union join: the rows of both tables under the union of their columns, null where a table lacks one. Keyed tables are merged by key.

name: ujf
summary: As uj, but for keyed tables a null in t2 leaves t1's value in place instead of replacing it.

name: ungroup
summary: Table t with each row of nested columns spread over one row per item: what xgroup did, undone.

name: union
summary: The distinct items of x followed by the items of y not among them.

name: update
summary: qSQL: t with the columns listed added or replaced, in the rows a where phrase selects. A table named by symbol is changed in place.

name: upper
summary: The string or symbol x in upper case.

name: upsert
summary: Table x with the records y added: appended, or for a keyed table written over the row with the same key. x may name a global table or a table on disk, which is then changed in place.

name: use
summary: KDB-X: loads the module named by symbol x and returns what it exports.

name: value
summary: The value of x, by its type: the global a symbol names, the result of a string of q or of a parse tree, a dictionary's values, the internals of a function.

name: var
summary: The population variance of x.

name: view
summary: The expression defining the view named by symbol x, as a string.

name: views
summary: The names of the views in a namespace, sorted; views[] lists the default namespace.

name: vs
summary: Vector from scalar. Splits the string y on separator x; gives the digits of y in base x; with ` splits a symbol at its dots, or a path into directory and file; with 0x0 or 0b gives a number's bytes or bits.

name: wavg
summary: The average of y weighted by x: the sum of x*y over the sum of x.

name: where
summary: The indices at which boolean x is 1b. For integers, each index repeated that many times; for a dictionary, its keys likewise.

name: while
summary: Evaluates the expressions in order, again and again for as long as test is nonzero. It returns nothing.

name: within
summary: Whether each item of x lies between the two bounds in y, both included.

name: wj
summary: Window join: for each row of t, the aggregates f of q's columns over the rows in its time window w, matched on the leading columns of c. The value prevailing as the window opens is included.

name: wj1
summary: As wj, but counting only the rows of q that fall inside the window, not the one prevailing as it opens.

name: wsum
summary: The weighted sum of y: the sum of x*y.

name: ww
summary: What wj and wj1 are both made from. It is not meant to be called directly.

name: xasc
summary: Table t sorted ascending by the columns named in c. A table named by symbol or file symbol is sorted where it is.

name: xbar
summary: y rounded down to the nearest multiple of x: 5 xbar 12 is 10. With a time span for x, it buckets times.

name: xcol
summary: Table t with columns renamed: its first columns to the names in list x, or by a dictionary from old name to new.

name: xcols
summary: Table t with the columns named in x moved to the front.

name: xdesc
summary: Table t sorted descending by the columns named in c. A table named by symbol or file symbol is sorted where it is.

name: xexp
summary: x raised to the power y, as a float.

name: xgroup
summary: Table t grouped by the columns named in c, which become its key; each other column holds a list per group.

name: xkey
summary: Table t keyed by the columns named in c; with an empty list, t with no key.

name: xlog
summary: The logarithm of y to base x.

name: xprev
summary: For each item of y, the one x places before it - after it for a negative x - and null where there is none.

name: xrank
summary: For each item of y, which of x buckets of equal size it falls in by value, from 0.

name: .Q.A
summary: The upper-case letters A to Z, as a string.

name: .Q.D
summary: The partitions in each segment of the segmented database that is loaded.

name: .Q.K
summary: The release date of the q.k this interpreter runs.

name: .Q.M
summary: How many rows .Q.dsftg reads at a time; 0W, the whole file, unless it is set.

name: .Q.MAP
summary: Keeps every partition of the loaded database mapped, saving the file-system calls a query would make to map them; called as .Q.MAP[].

name: .Q.PD
summary: Where each partition of the loaded database is, item by item with .Q.PV.

name: .Q.PV
summary: Every partition value of the loaded database, before .Q.view restricts them to .Q.pv.

name: .Q.V
summary: Table x, a partitioned one included, as a dictionary from each column name to its values.

name: .Q.a
summary: The lower-case letters a to z, as a string.

name: .Q.addmonths
summary: The date x plus y months, the day of the month carried over - so the 31st may spill into the month after.

name: .Q.addr
summary: The IP address of the host named by symbol x, as an integer.

name: .Q.an
summary: The characters a q name may hold: the letters, the underscore and the digits, as a string.

name: .Q.atob
summary: The bytes the base-64 string x encodes.

name: .Q.b6
summary: The 64 characters of base 64 - upper- and lower-case letters, digits, + and / - as a string.

name: .Q.bt
summary: Prints the backtrace of the calls that led here; called as .Q.bt[].

name: .Q.btoa
summary: The string or byte vector x encoded as base 64.

name: .Q.bv
summary: Builds .Q.vp, so a partitioned table missing from some partitions reads as empty there instead of failing; called as .Q.bv[].

name: .Q.bvi
summary: As .Q.bv, scanning only the partitions added since .Q.bv last ran.

name: .Q.chk
summary: Gives every partition of the database at directory x an empty copy of each table it is missing.

name: .Q.cn
summary: The number of rows of partitioned table x in each partition.

name: .Q.dd
summary: Symbols x and y joined with a dot: .Q.dd[`a;`b] is `a.b. A file symbol x is joined with a slash into a path: .Q.dd[`:db;`t] is `:db/t.

name: .Q.def
summary: The parsed command line y, as .Q.opt returns it, with the defaults in dictionary x filled in and each value cast to its default's type.

name: .Q.dpft
summary: Saves the global table named by symbol t as a splayed table in partition p of the database at directory d, sorted and parted on field f, its symbols enumerated against sym. Returns t.

name: .Q.dpfts
summary: As .Q.dpft, enumerating symbols against the file named by s instead of sym.

name: .Q.dpt
summary: As .Q.dpft, the table saved in the order it is in, with no field sorted or parted.

name: .Q.dpts
summary: As .Q.dpt, enumerating symbols against the file named by s instead of sym.

name: .Q.dsftg
summary: Reads fixed-width records from a file .Q.M rows at a time, applies g to each chunk, and appends it to a splayed table on disk.

name: .Q.en
summary: Table t with its symbol columns enumerated against the sym file in directory d, which is extended and written back as needed.

name: .Q.ens
summary: As .Q.en, enumerating against the file named by s instead of sym.

name: .Q.f
summary: The number y as a string with x digits after the decimal point.

name: .Q.fc
summary: f applied to the vector x, which is cut into pieces evaluated on the secondary threads.

name: .Q.ff
summary: Table x with each column of table y that x lacks appended, filled with nulls.

name: .Q.fk
summary: The name of the table column x is a foreign key into, or the null symbol when it is not one.

name: .Q.fmt
summary: The number z as a string x characters wide with y digits after the decimal point; asterisks when it does not fit.

name: .Q.fpn
summary: As .Q.fsn, reading from the named pipe x.

name: .Q.fps
summary: As .Q.fs, reading from the named pipe x.

name: .Q.fs
summary: Applies f to the text file x a chunk of whole lines at a time, for a file too large to read at once.

name: .Q.fsn
summary: As .Q.fs, in chunks of about n bytes.

name: .Q.ft
summary: The function x applied to keyed table y as to a simple table, and the result keyed as y was.

name: .Q.fu
summary: f applied to the distinct items of x only, with each result laid back where its item was - worthwhile when f is slow and x repeats itself.

name: .Q.gc
summary: Returns unused memory to the operating system, and how many bytes that was; called as .Q.gc[].

name: .Q.gz
summary: Compresses with gzip when x is a pair of level and data, and decompresses when x is bytes it compressed.

name: .Q.hdpf
summary: Saves every global table to partition p of the database at directory d, as .Q.dpft would with field f, empties them, and tells the process on handle h to reload.

name: .Q.hg
summary: The body of the reply to an HTTP GET of URL x, as a string.

name: .Q.host
summary: The name of the host at IP address x, an integer, as a symbol.

name: .Q.hp
summary: The body of the reply to an HTTP POST to URL x of the string z, sent with content type y.

name: .Q.id
summary: The symbol x, or the column names of table x, without the characters no q name may hold, and an a put before a leading digit or _: .Q.id`$"1a b" is `a1ab. A reserved word as a column name gets a 1 after it.

name: .Q.ind
summary: The rows of partitioned table x at the row numbers y, counted across all its partitions.

name: .Q.j10
summary: The string x, at most 10 characters of .Q.b6, encoded as a long; .Q.x10 decodes it, left-padded with "A" to 10 characters.

name: .Q.j12
summary: The string x, at most 12 characters of .Q.nA, encoded as a long; .Q.x12 decodes it, left-padded with "0" to 12 characters.

name: .Q.k
summary: The version of the q.k this interpreter runs, as a float.

name: .Q.l
summary: Loads the database or the directory of scripts at path x, as \l does.

name: .Q.ld
summary: The lines x of a script grouped into statements, each indented line joined to the one before, with the line number each starts at.

name: .Q.li
summary: Adds the partitions in x that are on disk to the database that is loaded.

name: .Q.lo
summary: Loads the database at path x; y says whether to change to its directory, and z whether to run the scripts it holds.

name: .Q.n
summary: The digits 0 to 9, as a string.

name: .Q.nA
summary: The digits and the upper-case letters, the 36 characters of base 36, as a string.

name: .Q.opt
summary: The command-line arguments x, as .z.x has them, as a dictionary from each option's name to the strings that follow it.

name: .Q.par
summary: The path of table t in partition p of the database at d, wherever par.txt puts that partition.

name: .Q.pd
summary: Where each partition of the loaded database is, as .Q.view has restricted them; item by item with .Q.pv.

name: .Q.pf
summary: The field a partitioned database is partitioned by - `date, `month, `year or `int - once one is loaded.

name: .Q.pn
summary: A dictionary from each partitioned table to its row count in each partition, as .Q.cn has counted them.

name: .Q.prf0
summary: A table of the call stack of the q process with PID x, as a sample for a profiler.

name: .Q.pt
summary: The names of the partitioned tables of the database that is loaded.

name: .Q.pv
summary: The partition values of the database that is loaded, as .Q.view has restricted them.

name: .Q.qp
summary: 1b when x is a partitioned table, 0b when it is a splayed one, and 0 for anything else.

name: .Q.qt
summary: 1b when x is a table, keyed or not.

name: .Q.res
summary: q's control words and keywords, as a list of symbols.

name: .Q.s
summary: x formatted as the console would show it, as one string with a newline after each line.

name: .Q.s1
summary: x as a string of q on one line, as -3! gives it.

name: .Q.sbt
summary: The backtrace object x, as .Q.trp hands one to its error handler, formatted as a string.

name: .Q.sha1
summary: The SHA-1 hash of string x, as 20 bytes.

name: .Q.t
summary: The type letters, indexed by type number: .Q.t 7 is "j", for long.

name: .Q.trp
summary: f applied to x; should that signal an error, g applied to the error message and a backtrace object.

name: .Q.trpd
summary: As .Q.trp for a function of any rank: x applied to the argument list y, and on an error z applied to the message and a backtrace object.

name: .Q.ts
summary: f applied to the argument list x, as a pair of the time and space \ts would report and the result.

name: .Q.ty

name: .h.HOME

The HTML line break, "
", as a string.

name: .h.cd

name: .h.code

name: .h.hb

name: .h.hc
summary: The string x with each < escaped as <.

name: .h.he

name: .h.hn
summary: An HTTP response with the status x, the content type y and the body z.

name: .h.hp

name: .h.hr

name: .h.htc

name: .h.html

name: .h.http
summary: The string x with each http:// URL in it made a link.

name: .h.hu
summary: The string x with each character a URI may not hold escaped as %xx.

name: .h.hug

name: .h.hy
summary: An HTTP 200 response with the content type named by symbol x and the body y.

name: .h.iso8601

name: .h.jx

name: .h.ka

name: .h.logo

name: .h.nbr

name: .h.pre
summary: The lines x in an HTML pre element, as one string.

name: .h.sa

summary: The CSS rules for the body of the web console, as a string.

name: .h.sc
summary: The characters a URI may hold unescaped, as a string.

name: .h.td

name: .h.text

name: .h.tx

name: .h.uh
summary: The string x with each %xx escape decoded.

name: .h.xd

name: .h.xmp

name: .z.D
summary: The current local date.

name: .z.H
summary: The handles of the sockets that are open, as a sorted list of ints.

name: .z.K
summary: The version of this q, as a float.

name: .z.N
summary: The current local time of day, as a timespan.

name: .z.P
summary: The current local time, as a timestamp.

name: .z.T
summary: The current local time of day, as a time in milliseconds.

name: .z.W
summary: A dictionary from each open connection handle to what is still queued to be sent on it, in bytes.

name: .z.X
summary: The whole command line the process was started with, as a list of strings.

name: .z.Z
summary: The current local time, as a datetime - a legacy type; .z.P is the timestamp.

name: .z.a
summary: The IP address of the host, as an integer.

name: .z.ac
summary: Called to authorize each HTTP request, with a pair of its text and a dictionary of its headers; what it returns says whether to let it in, and as whom.

name: .z.b
summary: A dictionary from each name a view reads to the views that depend on it.

name: .z.bm
summary: Called when a message arrives that cannot be read: a pair of the handle and the bytes received.

name: .z.c
summary: The number of physical cores.

name: .z.d
summary: The current UTC date.

name: .z.e
summary: The TLS details of the connection whose message is being evaluated, as a dictionary; empty when it is no TLS connection.

name: .z.exit
summary: Called with the exit code as the process is about to end.

name: .z.f
summary: The script the process was started with, as a symbol.

name: .z.h
summary: The name of the host the process runs on, as a symbol.

name: .z.i
summary: The process ID, as an integer.

name: .z.k
summary: The date this q was released.

name: .z.l
summary: The details of the licence the process runs under, as a list of strings.

name: .z.n
summary: The current UTC time of day, as a timespan.

name: .z.o
summary: The operating system and architecture q was built for, as a symbol: `l64, `m64, `w64 ...

name: .z.p
summary: The current UTC time, as a timestamp.

name: .z.pc
summary: Called with the handle of a connection that has just closed, by when the handle is no longer usable.

name: .z.pd
summary: The handles of the secondary processes peach shares work among: an int vector, or a function that returns one.

name: .z.pg
summary: Called with each synchronous message; what it returns is sent back. Unset, the message is evaluated.

name: .z.ph
summary: Called with each HTTP GET: a pair of the request text and a dictionary of its headers.

name: .z.pi
summary: Called with each line typed at the console, as a string.

name: .z.pm
summary: Called with each HTTP OPTIONS, PATCH, PUT or DELETE: a list of the method, the request text and a dictionary of its headers.

name: .z.po
summary: Called with the handle of a connection that has just opened, after .z.pw has let it in.

name: .z.pp
summary: Called with each HTTP POST: a pair of the request text and a dictionary of its headers.

name: .z.pq
summary: Called with each line a qcon client sends, as .z.pi is with the console's; unset, .z.pi is called.

name: .z.ps
summary: Called with each asynchronous message; what it returns is dropped. Unset, the message is evaluated.

name: .z.pw
summary: Called with the user, a symbol, and the password, a string, of an incoming connection; it is refused unless this returns 1b.

name: .z.q
summary: 1b when the process was started in quiet mode, with -q.

name: .z.r
summary: 1b where an update would be refused - under -b, or inside reval - and 0b elsewhere.

name: .z.s
summary: The function being evaluated, which lets a lambda call itself without a name.

name: .z.t
summary: The current UTC time of day, as a time in milliseconds.

name: .z.ts
summary: Called with the current timestamp every time the timer fires, at the interval \t sets in milliseconds.

name: .z.u
summary: The user the process runs as - inside a message handler, the user who sent the message - as a symbol.

name: .z.vs
summary: Called after a global is set, with its name and the indices assigned to - () when the whole value was.

name: .z.w
summary: The handle of the connection whose message is being evaluated; 0 at the console.

name: .z.wc
summary: Called with the handle of a WebSocket connection that has just closed.

name: .z.wo
summary: Called with the handle of a WebSocket connection that has just opened.

name: .z.ws
summary: Called with each WebSocket message, a string or a byte vector.

name: .z.x
summary: The command-line arguments that follow the script's name, as a list of strings.

name: .z.z
summary: The current UTC time, as a datetime - a legacy type; .z.p is the timestamp.
x plus y, item by item.
x minus y, item by item.
x times y, item by item.
x divided by y, item by item, always as a float.
The lesser of x and y, item by item; for booleans, logical AND. The same as and.
The greater of x and y, item by item; for booleans, logical OR. The same as or.
y with each null replaced by the item of x in its place, or by x when it is an atom.
1b where x equals y, item by item, numbers of different types compared by value; ~ compares whole values.
1b where x is not equal to y, item by item.
1b where x is less than y, item by item.
1b where x is at most y, item by item.
1b where x is greater than y, item by item.
1b where x is at least y, item by item.
1b when x and y are the same value, type and length included, and 0b otherwise.
A dictionary from the keys x to the values y. With an integer x and a table y, y keyed on its first x columns, or unkeyed when x is 0.
The first x items of y, or the last when x is negative, y repeated as needed. A pair x shapes y into a matrix; symbols x take those keys or columns.
y without its first x items, or the last when x is negative. A list x cuts y at those indices; a list or dictionary x without its item at y.
y cast to the type x names, by a char or a symbol; an upper-case char parses the string y. As $[c;t;f], the conditional.
The index of each y in list x, or count x where it is absent. With a number x, a random roll or deal; as ?[c;t;f], the vector conditional.
x applied to y, or indexed at y. @[x;i;f] amends x at the indices i, and @[f;y;e] traps an error in f y with e.
x applied to the list of arguments y, or indexed at depth by it. .[x;i;f] amends x at depth, and .[f;y;e] traps an error with e.
x and y joined into one list: two tables with the same columns, their rows; two dictionaries, merged, y's values winning.
Assigns y to the name x: x[i]:y amends the items at i, and x+:y is x:x+y. Alone in a lambda, :y returns y.
Alone, the identity function and the generic null. In a lambda, x::y assigns the global x; at the top level, it defines x as a view of y.
Each: f' applies f to the corresponding items of its arguments. Before a value, 'x signals the error x.
Each prior: f': applies f to each item of a list and the item before it.
Each right: x f/: y applies f to x and each item of y.
Each left: x f\: y applies f to each item of x and y.
Over: f/ folds f through a list, giving the last result; a unary f is applied over and over, a number of times or until the result stops changing.
Scan: as f/, keeping each result along the way.
